Scheduled increases · last checked 2026-10-31

AI API price increases already on the calendar.

Answer: 8 models in our dataset have an officially announced price increase. All are Google Gemini models: Gemini 4 Argon doubles on 2026-12-01 when its promotional rate ends, and Gemini 3.8 Flash, 3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash, 3.8 Flash TTS, 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS and Robotics ER 2 double on 2027-01-01. 2 billing rule changes are also dated: DeepSeek 2026-11-01, Google 2026-11-13 (see below). Every price is from the provider’s own pricing page, and each row links its source.

Billing rule changes

Not a list-price change, but changes what you pay for. Each is quoted from the provider’s own page.

00:00 Beijing time on 2026-11-01 (= 2026-10-31 16:00 UTC)		DeepSeekSearch API and Fetch API (incl. server-side tool calls via DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, Codex)Server-side Search and Fetch tool calls, currently free, start per-request billing.$0.75 per 1,000 successful requests (Search); $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests (Fetch)source · 2026-10-31

Gemini 4 Argon) on Google Cloud Agent PlatformWhen a completion exceeds 32K tokens, retrievable token usage is charged even if the request ultimately fails due to client or server timeouts (today only 200 responses are charged).Standard token rates for retrievable tokenssource · 2026-10-31

Batch, flex and cache-storage rates for these models double on the same dates; see each model page for the full breakdown. Argon’s current rate applies through 2026-11-30; the others through 2026-12-31.

Promotions with an end date but no published new price

  • OpenAI gpt-5.6-sol: $4.00 in / $20.00 out per 1M tokens (promotional), at least through 2026-11-21. OpenAI has not published the post-promotion price; we will log it when it appears. source · checked 2026-10-30

What it means for a monthly bill

A doubling is a doubling: at 800M input / 120M output tokens a month, Gemini 3.8 Flash goes from about $1,050 to about $2,100 a month on 2027-01-01. Put your own volumes into the calculator and compare alternatives before the effective date.
